name: Crawling hands
weakness: Undead: Crumble Undead spell and salve amulet work

locations.name: Slayer Tower (ground floor)
locations.how: Slayer Tower in Morytania (Slayer ring teleport works), ground floor.

locations.name: Meiyerditch Laboratories
locations.how: Meiyerditch Laboratories in Morytania.

tips: First Slayer monster you can kill (5 Slayer).
Crumble Undead and salve amulet work.
Bigger and Badder: 1/200 chance of a Crushing Hand superior.

name: Cave crawlers

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.how: Fairy ring AJR, then enter the dungeon.
locations.note: Low Defence players can use Ranged/Magic from wall safespots. 8 spawns.

locations.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
locations.how: Lumbridge Swamp, enter the caves.
locations.note: Exposed light sources explode here. 3 spawns.

locations.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
locations.how: Dorgesh-Kaan south dungeon.

locations.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik (icy)
locations.how: Ruins of Tapoyauik, Varlamore.

mustBring: Antidote++ or other poison protection (their poison is strong)
Bullseye or oil lantern (light source for Lumbridge Swamp Caves)

food.note: Max hit 3 (judgement); poison is the main danger

tips: They regenerate 1 HP every 5 ticks, so kill them quickly.
Use poison protection.
Cannon is allowed.

name: Banshees
weakness: Air spells (30%); undead - Crumble Undead and salve amulet work

locations.name: Slayer Tower (ground floor, east side)
locations.how: Slayer Tower in Morytania (Slayer ring teleport works), ground floor east side.
locations.note: 8 spawns. Safespot north of the staircase behind a standing torch.

mustBring: Earmuffs or Slayer helmet (stops the screams reducing stats and damaging you; max hit drops from 26 to 2)

gear.style: Ranged (magic-based attacks, so ranged armour gives better defence)

food.note: Max hit is 2 with earmuffs/Slayer helmet; 26 without

tips: Wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet at all times.
Salve amulet and Slayer helmet effects do not stack.
Cannon and thralls work.

name: Rockslugs

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.how: Fairy ring AJR, then enter the dungeon.

locations.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
locations.how: Lumbridge Swamp, enter the caves.

locations.name: Ynysdail Cavern
locations.how: Ynysdail (needs boat access).

locations.name: Tonali Cavern
locations.how: Tonali Cavern, Varlamore.

locations.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
locations.how: Dorgesh-Kaan south dungeon.

mustBring: Bag of salt (use on a rockslug at 4 or less HP to finish it; a Brine sabre removes the need)
tips: Unlock Slug Salter (10 Slayer points) to auto-salt below 4 HP.
Brine sabre removes the salt requirement.
Cannon and thralls work.

name: Cockatrice

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.how: Fairy ring AJR, then enter the dungeon.
locations.note: 7 spawns. Cannon cannot be set up here.

mustBring: Mirror shield or V's shield (blocks the piercing gaze that reduces stats every hit; mirror shield needs 20 Defence)
tips: Without the shield the gaze drains stats even while safespotting.
Slayer level 25 required.

name: Pyrefiends

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.how: Fairy ring AJR, then enter the dungeon.
locations.note: 13 spawns; safespots available. Cannon does not work here.

locations.name: Isle of Souls
locations.how: Isle of Souls.
locations.note: 10 spawns; cannon works in the burnt forest area.

locations.name: Smoke Dungeon
locations.how: Smoke Dungeon.

locations.name: Sisterhood Sanctuary
locations.how: Sisterhood Sanctuary.

locations.name: God Wars Dungeon
locations.how: God Wars Dungeon.

gear.style: Ranged or Magic (low magic defence); ranged armour helps against their magical melee

tips: Magic defence is low, so ranged and magic hit well.
Halberd is an alternative to melee.
Protect from Melee needs 43 Prayer.

name: Infernal mages

locations.name: Slayer Tower (1st floor UK / 2nd floor US)
locations.how: Slayer Tower in Morytania; take the south-east stairs past the Banshees, or 18 Agility broken window shortcut.

mustBring: Earmuffs or Slayer helmet (to avoid Banshee aggression if using the main stairs)

food.note: Max hit 8; Protect from Magic negates it (judgement)

tips: Protect from Magic negates their attack completely.
Slayer level 45 required.
18 Agility shortcut avoids the Banshees.

name: Gryphons

locations.name: Great Conch western cave
locations.how: Great Conch island (needs Troubled Tortugans quest and 45 Sailing).
locations.note: 18 spawns; multicombat in the south room.

locations.name: Great Conch eastern cave
locations.how: Great Conch island (needs Troubled Tortugans quest and 45 Sailing).

gear.style: Melee (stronger than magic despite air weakness)

tips: Their knockback special hits you if equipped weight is below 30kg; at 30kg+ they stun instead and you get a free hit.
51 Slayer needed.
Nieve/Duradel need the Wings Spread unlock (80 points).

name: Custodian stalkers

locations.name: Stalker Den (south-western side)
locations.how: Stalker Den; needs the Shadows of Custodia quest.

locations.name: Stalker Den (south-eastern and northern caverns)
locations.how: Stalker Den; needs the Shadows of Custodia quest.

tips: Assigned by Chaeldar, Mortimer and Nieve.
Drop broken antlers.

name: Cave horrors

locations.name: Mos Le'Harmless Cave
locations.how: Minigame Teleport to Trouble Brewing, ectophial to Port Phasmatys then charter ship, or Mos le'harmless teleport scroll.
locations.note: 70 spawns; safespots near the entrance using mushrooms and stalagmites.

mustBring: Witchwood icon or Protect from Melee (negates the special attack)
Light source (unless the fire of eternal light is lit)

food.note: Max hit 9; special deals 10% of base Hitpoints (judgement)

tips: Needs Cabin Fever quest and 58 Slayer.
Dwarf multicannon speeds up kills.
Witchwood icon reduces special frequency.

name: Venators

locations.name: Virer Hunting Ground
locations.how: Drakan's medallion to Castle Draken, bank chest in Sangvesti, portal, run south over the pillar (73 Agility shortcut, pickaxe for rubble).

locations.name: Apsul Hunting Ground
locations.how: Same route as Virer Hunting Ground.

mustBring: Ivandis flail, blisterwood flail, hallowed flail, Sunspear or blisterwood stakes (only things that damage them)
Earmuffs or Slayer helmet (reduces shriek damage)

food.note: Max hit 21; they heal when hitting you with melee (judgement)

tips: Needs The Blood Moon Rises and 74 Slayer.
Prayer negates ranged and most melee damage; shriek still hits through prayer and drains prayer.
Sunspear special drops hearts restoring prayer.

name: Aquanites

locations.name: Ynysdail Cavern
locations.how: Sail to Ynysdail (73 Sailing, adamant keel boat). Later, 70 Construction rowboat links Ynysdail and Gwenith.

tips: Attack with slash to sever their lure; stab Defence drops from 60 to 10.
Saradomin godsword special restores Prayer.
Bring a seed box; 78 Slayer needed.

name: Araxytes

locations.name: Araxyte Cave (Morytania Spider Cave, task-only area)
locations.how: Morytania Spider Cave, task-only area.

mustBring: Prayer and a way to stave off venom (venomous and numerous in multi-combat)

food.note: Max hit 13 with many venomous attackers (judgement)

tips: Level 96 variants are one of the fastest Slayer tasks.
Level 146 variants double common drops and aranea boots rate.
92 Slayer needed.
